purpose: Fail closed unless the immutable Foundation release binding, Universe registry projection, readiness-release ledger provenance and current deployment identity agree on one exact release.
invariants: CI success alone is never canonical production truth.
A release-ledger row is valid only when layer, source commit and canonical evidence URL match the immutable binding.
The Universe registry must project the exact current immutable binding and must be verified and deployed.
The current aligned deployment expectation must match the immutable binding source, runtime version and artifact.
Runtime health degradation remains a separate concern and must not be hidden by source-of-truth reconciliation.
The assertion endpoint is service-role-only and never mutates authoritative truth.
